Principle 12: What I Do During School Vacations
I would like to tell you about what I do during my school vacations.
We have two main school vacations.
One is during the summer and one is during the winter.
Summer vacation begins in July
and the winter vacation begins in December.
Even though we don’t go to public school during these vacations,
we still go to private academies.
The best part is we have a lot more free time
that we spend doing things we like.
I spend my summer vacation a bit different from the winter one.
During summer vacation,
my family usually goes on a short trip to visit our relatives.
Last summer vacation, our family went to the seaside next to the East Sea.
Every holiday, there are major traffic jams,
and it takes a long time to go a very short distance.
It is also very hot for traveling.
Even if it is terribly hot during the summer,
I am happy to travel with my family anyways.
During winter vacation, we don’t travel very often.
However, last year we went on a short skiing trip to KangWon Province.
My mother wants me to study more, so every day during winter break,
she makes me study.
Because I like to read by myself, I usually read a lot during vacation.
I like vacations because I have more freedom to do what I want.
Many of my friends have been overseas on vacations.
My dream vacation is to travel abroad to an English-speaking country.
I have been learning English for three years
from my private academy teacher.
He is Canadian and has been telling us a lot about Canada.
I would love to go there sometime in the future
so that I can use all of the English I have learned.
